name: continue

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: OpenAI API key. One of OPENAI_API_KEY or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is required.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Anthropic API key for Claude-backed sessions.

CONTINUE_CONFIG_PATH.description: Path to a Continue config.json. Defaults to ~/.continue/config.json.

notes: IDE-native coding assistant. Wraps Continue's core library through a stdio MCP shim so ONEXUS can dispatch edit/explain tasks the same way the VS Code extension does.
